$comment: The rive-mcp commit this repo builds rigs with and measures them against. Rigging is generated, not authored (art-pipeline.md section 3), and the generator lives in another repository — so 'which version' has until now been tribal knowledge carried in commit messages. It is pinned here because the CLI plays two different roles and both of them want a fixed version. As a BUILDER its output is committed: a rig regenerated by a different version is a different binary, and the manticore mesh bug (art-pipeline.md section 6.3) is what a silently-moving builder looks like. As a RENDERER it is the measuring instrument for art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and a measuring instrument that drifts turns a green gate into a coin toss — the rest floor is 99.80% and two manticore tiers sit at 99.97%, so there is 0.17 points of room for a renderer that rasterises differently. CI reads `ref` from this file, so bumping the renderer is a visible commit that runs every gate against the new one rather than a change nobody can see. Bump it deliberately: `npm run art:rig:setup` builds the CLI at the new ref, `npm run art:rig:build` rebuilds the rigs, then run art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and commit the pin with whatever the rebuild changed. `npm run art:rig:build -- --check` is how the pin and the committed rigs are known to agree: it rebuilds all 54 with the pinned CLI and compares bytes, and CI runs it on any pull request that touches a rig input, this file included.
$refComment: rive-mcp dccb540 (branch claude/jolly-goldberg-wropu4, on top of main a70e13e). Adds two rig options. `underpaint` (every config sets 48) grows each part under the parts of its own line drawn over it, near the joint and from visible paint, only beneath opaque pixels, so a rotating joint reveals fur instead of background (art-pipeline.md section 6.4). `--pivots` pins each joint from the part set's joints.json instead of measuring it from the overlap, so art recut with real seam bands keeps its pivots (docs/briefs/part-recut.md). Rest pose unchanged on all 66 rigs; filled PNGs are encoded deterministically so art:rig:build --check stays byte-exact. A config without either builds the same bytes as a70e13e.
